adverse_media_found.description: True if any credible adverse media, scam reports, or fraud allegations were found

summary.description: 1-3 sentence summary of findings, or confirmation that no adverse media was found

hits.description: Top adverse media items found — at most 5, prioritised by severity

snippet.description: Relevant excerpt or context from the source

risk_indicators.description: Specific risk signals found, e.g. 'FCA enforcement action 2023', 'multiple Trustpilot complaints'
